claims: Full Social Security benefits for those born in 1960 or later start at age 67.
Full Retirement Age (FRA) for Social Security for those born 1955-1959 is 66 and a few months.
Full Retirement Age (FRA) for Social Security for those born 1954 or earlier is 66.
Claiming Social Security at 62 results in up to 30% smaller payments.
Delaying Social Security until 70 increases benefits by 8% annually.
